豆科植物固氮如何同时减少化肥需求和氧化亚氮排放？

How does legume nitrogen fixation cut both fertilizer need and N2O emissions?

根瘤菌把空气中的氮直接变成植物可吸收的形式，减少合成氮肥施用；而化肥过量正是农田氧化亚氮（强温室气体）的主要来源，少施就少排。
Rhizobia convert atmospheric N into plant-usable form, reducing synthetic fertilizer; excess fertilizer is the main farm source of N2O, a potent greenhouse gas, so less application means less emission.

免耕和覆盖作物是怎样提升土壤有机碳的？

How do no-till and cover crops build soil organic carbon?

免耕减少土壤翻动导致的碳暴露与侵蚀，覆盖作物在休耕期持续给土壤输入根系与残体有机质，二者共同增加土壤碳储并改善团粒结构。
No-till limits carbon exposure and erosion from turning soil; cover crops keep feeding roots and residues into soil during fallow, together raising soil carbon and structure.

“食物里程”真能全面衡量一盘食物的碳足迹吗？

Can 'food miles' fully measure a meal's carbon footprint?

不能。对牛羊肉而言，反刍动物肠道甲烷往往占其碳足迹大头，远超运输；本地化对低排放强度的蔬果更有意义，整体需看全生命周期。
No. For beef and lamb, ruminant methane often dominates the footprint, far above transport; localization matters more for low-emission produce; the whole life cycle counts.
